title: 1.13 Ana's Party!
unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people's habits in Spanish.
goal: Help Ana start her party, then answer her friends out loud.
grammar_function: All Spanish A1+ Unit 1 patterns, in a mission.
speaking_outcome: Help Ana start her party, then answer her friends out loud.

cards.audio_text: Él es alto. Ella tiene el pelo largo. Ella es baja. Él tiene barba.
cards.spanish_translation: He is tall. She has long hair. She is short. He has a beard.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 01/11: the guests arrive at Ana's family party; the learner hears one description and discovers how the game responds, then finds the other three guests (1.1).

audio_assets.text: Ana is getting a party ready with her family and friends. Listen to each sentence and find who it describes. At the end, answer her friends' questions out loud for Ana to start the party. First we will practice together.

cards.audio_text: Él es mayor. Ella es joven. Ella es mayor. Él es joven.
cards.spanish_translation: He is old. She is young. She is old. He is young.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 02/11: the guests sit down at the party table; old and young (1.1).

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen to one sentence at a time and tap who it describes.

cards.audio_text: Él toma café. Ella come pastel. Él cocina pollo. Ella lee un libro.
cards.spanish_translation: He drinks coffee. She eats cake. He cooks chicken. She reads a book.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 03/11: the party begins and each guest does one thing; the he/she -s (1.2).

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen to one sentence at a time and tap who it describes.

cards.audio_text: La niña nada. El niño corre. El hombre canta. La mujer baila.
cards.spanish_translation: The girl swims. The boy runs. The man sings. The woman dances.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 04/11: by the pool the party grows louder; more he/she -s verbs (1.2-1.3).

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen to one sentence at a time and tap who it describes.

options.label: El perro juega con su pelota.
options.spanish_translation: The dog plays with its ball.

options.label: El gato está en su cama.
options.spanish_translation: The cat is on its bed.

cards.audio_text: El perro juega con su pelota. El gato está en su cama. El pájaro toma su agua. El conejo come su comida.
cards.spanish_translation: The dog plays with its ball. The cat is on its bed. The bird drinks its water. The rabbit eats its food.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 05/11: the friends' pets come to the party too, each with its own thing (1.10).

cards.audio_text: Ella baila con él. Él juega fútbol con ellos. Ella lee con ella. Él cocina con ella.
cards.spanish_translation: She dances with him. He plays football with them. She reads with her. He cooks with her.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 06/11: everyone does something together; him, her and them (1.11).

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen to one sentence at a time and tap who it describes.

options.label: Él no toma café. Él toma té.
options.spanish_translation: He doesn't drink coffee. He drinks tea.

cards.audio_text: Él no toma café. Él toma té. Ella toma café. Él toma agua. Ella toma jugo.
cards.spanish_translation: He doesn't drink coffee. He drinks tea. She drinks coffee. He drinks water. She drinks juice.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 07/11: a complete negative clue finds one guest at the table: he doesn't drink coffee, he drinks tea (1.8); then the other three drinks.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and answer out loud for Ana.

cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 09/11: Sofia asks where Ana's uncle lives (1.4, 1.9).

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and answer out loud for Ana.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and answer out loud for Ana.

cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 11/11: Luis asks the name of Ana's rabbit; the learner's answer starts the party (1.10).

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and answer to start the party.
